text: Been holding on this line for ages and now texting instead. I'm a childminder, girl aged 11, parents are on their way back but stuck in traffic. Temp was 38.9. When the ibuprofen kicks in she's honestly fine, playing, drinking her squash, chatting away. But I think she's breathing really fast, I counted and it seems quick, and I'm not sure but it looks like her skin pulls in under her ribs when she breathes in. She also keeps covering her eyes and says the big light hurts, so I've turned it off and put the lamp on. I need someone to actually tell me what to do here please.
